author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using ZipWall poles to build a dust barrier around this fireplace. I also like using two heavy duty zippers to create a door which can be propped up to get tools in the workspace. It’s important to keep dust confined to the work area, especially for homeowners with respiratory problems
title: ZipWall Barrier Tips for Fireplace Renovation - #zipwall #dustprotection
